title: Intrinsic Ext determinant is quotient-linear
statement: The intrinsic Ext determinant isomorphism is linear for the quotient action.

proof.text: This is the corresponding strictly smaller part of the intrinsic determinant argument in Tag 0BQZ, separated from the other clause so that the parent theorem is obtained by conjunction.

lean.statement: theorem intrinsic_ext_determinant_multiplication (A : Type uT) [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{uT + 1} (ModuleCat.{uT} A)] (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (hex : ∃ f : Fin r → A, RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f ∧ Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I) : ∃ e : Abelian.Ext (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)) (ModuleCat.of A A) r ≃ₗ[A] koszulNormalDeterminant A I r, ∀ (b : A ⧸ I) (x : Abelian.Ext (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)) (ModuleCat.of A A) r), e ((Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (ModuleCat.ofHom (b • (LinearMap.id : (A ⧸ I) →ₗ[A] (A ⧸ I))))).comp x (zero_add r)) = @SMul.smul (A ⧸ I) (⋀[A ⧸ I]^r (Module.Dual (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent)) inferInstance b (e x)
